title: Missing oracle updates in `RewardsManager`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `RewardsManager.getAccruedYield()` function calculates rewards based on oracle prices but fails to call `_tryUpdateOracle()` before fetching prices.
